summary: Layer 3 ranking prioritizes restaurant supply-chain and infrastructure nodes where demand durability, bottleneck characteristics, public-market purity, evidence quality, and underfollowed discovery are strongest. The highest-priority candidates in this chunk are Lamb Weston, Performance Food Group, Olo, PAR Technology, and Farmer Bros. Domino's is retained as a reference leader but is not allowed to dominate the ranking because its stock is already highly followed. Small/mid-cap or niche candidates receive higher underfollowed_discovery scores only where there is a plausible hidden restaurant-system signal and a clear verification path.
